title: Low-cell bound
statement: For a program $P$, a Boolean flag $d$, and resource limits, define the low-cell bound to be the larger of twice the stack-cell count for $P$ under those limits and $25$ plus four times the dispatcher position for $P$ and $d$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the stack-cell count or dispatcher position.
